page.layout: One printed page, single text block with notes in the left margin. Running head top centre, page number top left. Text column in the centre. Left margin: notes "III. Cataica", "(1.) Sinensis", "Sinensis regni ortus." No right margin notes. Right edge shows the neighbouring page's text, not transcribed.

main_text.p: autem Zebut, Molucca, Philippi-na, Borneo, Gilolo, Timor, Banda, Amboyna, Sumatra & Maldivæ. Hæ Maldivæ plus quàm 1100. Insulas amplectuntur, & in XIII Atollas sive provincias dividuntur, quæ omnes unum regem agnoscunt.
main_text.head: CATAICA.
main_text.p: Cataica est vel Sinensis, vel Coreana, vel Japonica.
Cataicam vocamus quicquid intra Tartariam & Indiam, Orientem versus, terrarum Insularumq; situm est.
main_text.head: SINENSIS.
Periodus 1.
main_text.p: Sinensis regni ortus.Regnum Sinæ antiquissimum perhibetur.

page.notes: Printed hand/manicule symbol after "Japonica" and the arrow-like mark beside "Explicatio:" are printer's ornaments, not text. The note "III. Cataica" stands beside the CATAICA heading and is placed at the start of the following paragraph; "(1.) Sinensis" stands beside SINENSIS and is placed at the start of "Canon I.". The "Philippi-na" hyphen is read as a line-end hyphen. Right edge fragment "Ex" and the right-side text belong to the neighbouring page and were left out. No catchword or signature visible.
